title: nth Term of AP
description: Calculates the nth term of an arithmetic progression.

example.question: Find the 10th term of the AP 3, 7, 11, ...

title: Sum of n Terms of AP
description: Calculates the sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression.

example.question: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of the AP 3, 7, 11, ...

note: Useful for finding the total of consecutive AP terms.

title: nth Term of GP
description: Calculates the nth term of a geometric progression.

example.question: Find the 5th term of the GP 2, 4, 8, ...

note: Each term is multiplied by the common ratio.

title: Sum of n Terms of GP
description: Calculates the sum of the first n terms of a geometric progression when r ≠ 1.

example.question: Find the sum of the first 4 terms of 2, 4, 8, 16, ...

title: Sum of Infinite GP
description: Calculates the sum of an infinite geometric progression when |r| < 1.
note: Applicable only when |r| is less than 1.
